//: The lone version this site blesses its pages with — SITE-OWNED, deliberately.
It used to live in vendor/conformance-kit/gates/semantic/deno.json, which is inside
the kit's hash-pinned integrity manifest. That made the version specifier the KIT's
to choose, so moving it meant either editing a vendored copy (diverging it from
upstream, which is the exact drift the hash pin exists to detect) or re-vendoring the
whole kit to change one string. Neither is right: WHICH lone to run is a consumer
decision, and the lockfile that pins it — semantic/deno.lock — was already here.
The kit still owns gate.ts, the runner. It just no longer owns the version.
